system.description: You mark an ally with a permanent, glowing sigil. Only one ally can be anointed at a time.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the sigil also lets you sense the ally's direction and whether they live.
outcomes.success: The ally cannot be Charmed, Doomed or made a Dark Vessel. If they die, their soul is taken to your deity's realm and cannot be raised as undead.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the sigil fades by morning.
outcomes.ruin: The sigil burns wrong: the ally is Frightened of you until their next Long Rest. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
